cards.name: Cutpurse
cards.text: REACT: An opponent enters a market room. [Lockpick] -OR- 2 coin. You may discard a card to get both.
cards.flavor: Watch your money in the market.

cards.name: Spiritual Healer
cards.text: If you have a Gem in your play area or discard pile, heart and +1 Clank!
cards.arrive: You may make +2 Clank! to heart (heal 1).
cards.flavor: If you doubt the crystal is necessary, just wait for the loud chanting.

cards.name: Virtuoso Burglar
cards.text: -2 Clank! Trash a Burgle in your play area or discard pile.
cards.arrive: You may make +1 Clank! to trash a Burgle from your hand or discard pile.
cards.flavor: Want it done right? Call her.

cards.name: Rebel Herald
cards.text: If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card.
cards.reactCondition: There are two or more companions in the dungeon row.
cards.flavor: The most enduring friendships begin with a proper introduction.

cards.name: Tactician
cards.text: You can't really disrupt his plan. He'll just devise a new one.
cards.reactCondition: There are three or more empty spaces in the dungeon row.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.text: For each Clank! you make this turn, 1 coin.
cards.flavor: The screaming is a plus, you see. It draws more enemies to the fight.

cards.name: Assassin
cards.reactCondition: A monster arrives in the dungeon row.
cards.flavor: Her clientele consists mostly of dungeon delvers and politicians.

cards.name: Royal Brat
cards.text: If you have a crown, take a minor secret.
cards.reactCondition: An opponent takes a major secret, or any two secrets in a single turn.
cards.flavor: It's mine! I want it now!

cards.name: Flawed Ruby
cards.acquire: +2 Clank!, each other player gets +1 Clank!

cards.name: Flawed Sapphire
cards.acquire: +2 Clank!, each other player gets +1 Clank!

cards.name: Flawed Emerald
cards.acquire: +2 Clank!, each other player gets +1 Clank!

cards.name: Scouting Ahead
cards.text: You don't have to stop in Crystal Caves this turn.
cards.reactCondition: An opponent ends their turn in a Crystal Cave.
cards.flavor: Stay here. Catch your breath. I'll see what's in the next passage.

cards.name: Too Bad for You
cards.reactCondition: An opponent ends their turn with 2 or more of their Clank! in the Clank! area.
cards.flavor: Maybe the next time you try that, you should limber up first.

cards.name: One With Everything
cards.flavor: Open your mind to little opportunities and they'll add up to a big windfall.

cards.name: Time Warp
cards.reactCondition: An opponent doesn't move during their turn.
cards.flavor: This form of magical travel begins with a jump to the left.

cards.name: Walk It Off
cards.reactCondition: There is a dragon attack in which you take damage.
cards.flavor: 'Tis but a scratch. I've had worse.

cards.name: Elven Satchel
cards.flavor: Great for carrying a travel cloak, dagger, and spare boots.

cards.name: Hiding Place
cards.arrive: You may discard a Burgle to get -2 Clank!
cards.flavor: It's camouflage AND a weapons cache!

cards.name: Secret Passage
cards.arrive: You may spend 5 coin to acquire a Secret Tome.
cards.flavor: Never judge a bookcase by what it covers.

cards.name: Pixie Swarm
cards.arrive: Each player who reveals a [Burgle] from their hand gets 1 coin.
cards.flavor: Nobody invades our territory. Let's get 'em!

cards.name: Spotter
cards.text: DEFEAT: Each player may make +1 Clank! to get 2 coin. You also get -2 Clank!
cards.flavor: Even a dragon with six heads can use extra eyes in his dungeon.

cards.name: Leprechaun
cards.flavor: Not especially tough, but they do hiss loudly when you get near.

cards.name: Scuffler
cards.text: DEFEAT: Each opponent chooses: -2 Clank! -OR- 2 coin -OR- Trash a Burgle in your discard pile. You get all three.
cards.flavor: Don't waste a good weapon battling a scuffler.

cards.name: Succubus
cards.text: DEFEAT: Each opponent chooses: 3 coin -OR- heart. You get both.
cards.flavor: Even if you don't see the allure, you'll reap the rewards.

cards.name: Ape Lord Phantasm
cards.text: DEFEAT: Draw two cards. Players may return any monkey idols to the monkey shrine room to take a Secret Tome for each.
cards.flavor: Some treasure isn't worth the nightmare that follows.
